Boulder Red Barn T-Shirt Giveaway: 15 Free Red Barn Shirts!

The original Lensworth Impressionist Red Barn picture which appears on the T-Shirts. By Lenny “Lensworth” Frieling

Have You Seen Boulder’s Red Barn?

AboutBoulder Is Giving Away 15 T-Shirts

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 4:59
Instaread

Something unexpected is happening around Boulder. It started with a sketch, then a palette knife painting, and  then came a T-shirt, and then people started wearing it. Before long, one question kept coming up: Where can I get one?

The response to the new Boulder Red Barn T-shirt featuring the artwork of Lenny “Lensworth” Frieling has been overwhelming. People wearing the shirt are getting comments and questions about it. Friends want one. Readers want one. There seems to be something about that brilliant red barn beneath the Colorado mountains that immediately connects with people.

Maybe it’s nostalgia. Maybe it’s the simplicity of the image. Or maybe it’s because one look at the Red Barn simply feels like Boulder.

Whatever the reason, people are talking about it. To celebrate the response, AboutBoulder.com is giving away 15 Red Barn T-shirts, free of charge and on a first-come, first-served basis. No purchase is necessary.

But the Red Barn is only half the story. The other half is the Boulder original who created it.

Meet Lensworth

Lenny “Lensworth” Frieling has spent more than 50 years in Boulder, building a résumé almost as colorful as his artwork. He’s a former (now retired from the bar) attorney, former judge, published author, lecturer, writer, artist, photographer and longtime AboutBoulder contributor.

AboutBoulder readers know him best as Lensworth, the man who seems to find a photograph everywhere he looks. His camera has captured the Flatirons, spectacular Colorado sunrises, wildlife, flowers, birds, the moon, the Continental Divide and hundreds of those unexpected Boulder moments most of us walk right past.

Large Nymph Butterflies Posing For The Camera. Photo: Lenny “Lensworth” Frieling

That work earned Lenny AboutBoulder’s 2023 Photographer of the Year honor. He was later named AboutBoulder’s Blogger of the Year, and his photography and writing have developed a loyal following through over 550 published features. He is widely syndicated with both his pictures and his blogs.

Then the award-winning photographer and blogger picked up a palette knife. Starting with a palette knife, a pencil, and a canvas, he ended up with his now famous Red Barn picture.

St. Malo’s church and Longs Peak. This photo got many thousands of views. Photo: Lenny “Lensworth” Frieling.

The Red Barn Takes Off

Lenny’s first Red Barn painting captured a classic Boulder County scene: a brilliant red barn surrounded by green countryside with the snow-covered Continental Divide rising behind it.

The image celebrates something deeper than a beautiful landscape. Boulder County’s farms, barns and open spaces remain reminders of the agricultural heritage of Colorado and an important part of the character of this region.

Then the Red Barn made its way onto a T-shirt.

That’s when things really took off.

People noticed it. They asked about it.  People were literally stopping Lensworth on the street to rave about his Red Barn T-Shirt. They wanted to know where it came from and how they could get one. The response from people wearing and seeing the shirts has been extraordinary.

Perhaps that’s because this isn’t another generic Colorado souvenir. It’s original artwork created by a longtime Boulder photographer and artist who has spent decades observing, documenting and celebrating this community.

Wear It Around Boulder

If you get one, we’d love to see where your Red Barn ends up.

Wear it beneath the Flatirons. Take it to Pearl Street. Chautauqua. Your favorite trail. Another Colorado barn. Or take it somewhere completely unexpected.

Send us a photograph of you or someone you gave the shirt to, wearing your shirt, and we’ll feature some of our favorites in a future AboutBoulder story.

The reaction to the Red Barn has also gotten us thinking about what’s next. Lenny has spent decades building an extraordinary archive of Boulder photography, and now his original artwork is opening another creative chapter starting with the Barn Series.

The Red Barn and the Barn Series is just the beginning.

A Boulder Original

Former judge. Attorney. Published Author. Artist. Photographer of the Year. Blogger of the Year. The list of bullet points goes on.

There are plenty of ways to describe Lenny “Lensworth” Frieling.

We prefer something simpler: He’s a Boulder original.

And it seems fitting that one Boulder original created an image celebrating another — a classic red barn standing beneath the Colorado mountains.

The response has already exceeded anything we expected. Now we’re sharing the excitement with the people who make AboutBoulder possible: YOU! Our faithful readers.

The Red Barn Giveaway

15 Red Barn T-shirts. Free. First come, first served.

If you’ve been wondering where you can get one, here’s your chance to not only get a Red Barn T-Shirt, but to get one free!

Send an email with your Unisex T-Shirt size, snail mail address, email, and optional phone to lfrieling@lfrieling.com 

The first 15 emails received on or after 5:30 AM MT on Thursday, August 27, 2026 will receive the free shirts. One per household.  

Lenny “Lensworth” Frieling   (720) 320-6201

The Lensworth ebay store  is also now open!
